bulk.intro: Copy each investment's current value from your bank's app. Only what changed is saved.

empty.title: No investments
empty.description: Just say how much you have in each investment today. Then update the value every now and then.

fixedIncome.title: Fixed income: when you can withdraw
fixedIncome.dailyHint: A good place for your emergency fund.
fixedIncome.unknown: <value/> without liquidity set. Edit the investment to classify it.
fixedIncome.noMaturities: Nothing matures in the next 12 months.

errors.rate: Invalid rate. Use something like 110 or 6.5.
errors.current: Enter how much you have today.
errors.quantity: Enter the quantity to use the quote.

form.currentHint: The value shown today in your bank's or brokerage's app. It goes into your net worth, not as an expense.
form.name: Name (optional)
form.rateHint: For reference only. It's in the investment details in your bank's app (e.g. “92% of CDI”).
form.history: I know how much and when I invested
form.historyHint: Optional. Without it, returns are counted from today.
form.autoQuoteHint: Value = quantity × quote in reais, refreshed every 5 minutes. Turn it off to type the value yourself.

errors.noAccount: Add an account first: the money has to come from somewhere or go back to it.
errors.value: Enter what the investment is worth on that date.

detail.movementHint: It only moves money around: it's neither an expense nor income.
detail.valueHint: Copy the value from your bank's or brokerage's app. Future contributions add on top of it.
detail.quantityHint: The position’s quantity is updated too.

preview.title: Return preview
preview.subtitle: {{rate}}% of CDI on the current value
preview.note: Estimate with a constant CDI; it doesn't change the position's value, which follows your updates.

quote.stale: Couldn't refresh the quote. Keeping the last value.
quote.unavailable: Quote unavailable right now. Keeping the last value.

bitcoin.invalid: Invalid quantity. In sats, use whole numbers only; in BTC, up to 8 decimal places.

costBasis.averageUnit: You paid {{price}} per unit on average
costBasis.note: Unrealized: how much the coins you still hold gained since you bought them.
costBasis.noteWithSales: Unrealized: how much the coins you still hold gained. Realized: what you won or lost on sales.
costBasis.missing: Add the quantity to contributions and redemptions to see the average price.
